 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice M.Nagaprasanna
 Oral Order
The petitioners are before this Court calling in question proceedings in C.C.No.42/2024, pending
before the Principal Civil Judge and Jmfc Court, Chintamani, Chikkaballapura District, for the
offences under Sections 498A, 323 and 504 of the Ipc and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry
Prohibition Act.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2, in unison submit that the parties to the lis were before the concerned Court in Crl.Misc.No.77/2024 and have settled their issue by drawing up certain terms and conditions of NC: 2024:KHC:37249 settlement.
They would submit that the parties to the lis are living together happily and respondent No.2 is staying with her husband and his family members since then.
The parties have filed an application under Sections 320(2) r/w. 482 of the Cr.P.C., seeking permission to compound the offences along with an affidavit to that effect before this Court.
One of the conditions of the settlement recognizes the closure of the present proceedings.

3. The affidavit filed by the parties to the lis along with the application, reads as follows:
"1. We state that 1st petitioner is the husband, 2nd petitioners mother-in-law and 2nd Sri. Srikanta. B. V vs State By Chintamani Town Police on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27145971/
2 respondent is the wife of the 1st petitioner in the above case and we are well conversant with the facts and circumstances of the case.
2. I, the 2nd respondent had lodged a case against petitioners for the offences punishable U/s 498(A) 323, 504 of IPC and U/s 3 & 4 of DP Act,

entities.text: Srikanta. B. V vs State By Chintamani Town Police on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: pending on the file of Pri. Civil Judge (Sr. Dn) & JMFC Court at Chintamani.

3. We state that since the alleged offences are non- compoundable in nature, we are filing the annexing application seeking permission of this Hon'ble Court to compound the said offences and to acquit the petitioners.

4. We the 2nd respondent and 1st petitioner state that as per clause/ Para 9 of the Memorandum of Settlement under section 89 of C.P.C read with Rule 24 & 25 of the Karnataka Civil Procedure (Mediation) rule 2005 which entered in Cri. Misc.
No.77/2024 on the file of this VI MMTC, at Bengaluru that the 1st petitioner and 2nd NC: 2024:KHC:37249 respondent shall take such steps as permissible in law to bring about a closure to the proceedings in C.C.No.42/2024 (Crime.No.205/2023) on the file of Pri.Civil and JMFC Chintamani, Chikkaballapur District, and the 2nd respondent to give consent to quash the entire charge sheet against the petitioners.

Wherefore, we the petitioners and 2nd respondent pray that this Hon'ble court may be pleased to quash the entire proceedings in C.C.No. 42/2024 (Crime No.205/2023)
of Chinthamani Town Police Station, Chikkaballapur District registered for the offences punishable U/s 498(A) 323, 504 of IPC and U/s 3 & 4 of DP Act, pending on the file of Pri Civil Judge & JMFC Court at Chintamani Chikkaballapur District in the interest of Justice."

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the light of the afore-quoted affidavit of the parties and the fact that they are living together happily, though the offences alleged against the petitioner in the case at hand inter alia is one punishable under Section 498A of the IPC, I deem it appropriate to accept the affidavit of settlement and permit them to compound the offences, as the allegations are not against the State.

4. For the aforesaid reasons, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The criminal petition is disposed.

NC: 2024:KHC:37249 (ii) The proceedings in C.C.No.42/2024, pending before the Principal Civil Judge and JMFC Court,
Chintamani, Chikkaballapura District, stand quashed.
